title: JSON body parser with content-type check and byte cap
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the settled flag and req.destroy() as clumsy, or the empty-body shortcut as lax. The parser fails closed at each step: a non-JSON content type is rejected before any bytes are read, chunk lengths are Buffer byte counts (not string lengths, so multi-byte characters cannot sneak past the cap), exceeding the cap answers 413 and destroys the socket so the client cannot keep streaming, the settled flag makes the data/end/error handlers mutually exclusive after any terminal outcome, malformed JSON is a 400 rather than a thrown 500, and an empty body maps to {} only because the routes behind this parser treat it as 'no fields'.

label_amendments.finding_title: req.destroy() right after 413 can RST the socket and drop the response

adjudication.probe_detail: No executable probe was specified for this finding (claim not a concrete input->crash/wrong-output claim).
